## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues and include screenshots for UI changes.

## Testing

List commands run and their results, plus any relevant manual checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing patterns.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate tests, or this change does not affect behavior.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] Both Turkish and English strings are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, personal/client data, private transcripts, or local app data are included.
